title: ResNet: Deep Residual Learning: Part 3 - The 152-Layer Architecture: Bottleneck Residual Blocks and Dimension Projections

beats.text: Why is ResNet a major breakthrough? Because deeper neural networks are more difficult to train.
The core challenge? this breakthrough introduces a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously.
beats.visual_focus: Bottleneck diagram illustrating resource contention and latency walls.

beats.text: Enter ResNet: we explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions.
beats.visual_focus: Split-screen contrasting traditional approaches with ResNet.
